Fundamentals, PCS, and earnings nuggets intentionally PENDING_DATA until the first fetch cycle and screen refresh run against live data — no numbers are invented here.

picks_and_shovels.thesis_1line: Dry-type transformers for data centers; the kind of small non-US name the attention gap actually hides.

second_order.name: Siemens Energy
second_order.thesis_1line: Grid Technologies + gas services backlog; the European mirror of GEV with historically cheaper multiple and thin US retail attention.
